lead_title: Get your personal roadmap from a career expert
lead_text: Tell us your class. A counsellor calls you with two or three paths that fit your marks and budget.

faqs.q: When should I start planning my career?
faqs.a: Class 9 or 10 is the best time to start, because the stream you pick after Class 10 decides which entrance exams you can take. Earlier classes are for exploring interests.

faqs.q: Can I become a doctor if I took PCM?
faqs.a: Not through NEET UG unless you add Biology. NEET needs Physics, Chemistry and Biology in Class 12. Some boards let you take Biology as an additional subject.
No. Commerce also leads to B.Com, BBA, economics, banking, company secretary and management. CA, CS and CMA are the professional routes.
They are typical durations for full-time study in India. Your actual time can be longer if you take a drop year, repeat an exam or study part-time.
